title: Misalignment of LLM-Generated Personas with Human Perceptions in Low-Resource Settings
findings: LLMs performed poorly when representing religious personas, with religion being the most challenging axis of identity evaluated. The performance was particularly low for religious minorities like the Buddhist persona, indicating unstable performance possibly due to uneven instruction-tuning data and inconsistently encoded persona cues. Human responses significantly outperformed all LLMs on all metrics for all religious personas.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the ability of LLMs to authentically represent religious personas (Muslim, Hindu, Christian, Buddhist) from a low-resource environment (Bangladesh) by evaluating their responses to culturally and religiously specific questions against human responses.
